# Selected direction

Replace the legacy discovery helper with the schema-v4 helper. Change only the caller and helper files named in this fixture. Preserve sorted report output. First migrate `scenario/src/report_tasks.py` to `scenario/src/teamwork_index_v4.py`; only after the caller migration and its proof may `scenario/src/legacy_index.py` be removed. Prove the result with `python3 -m unittest discover -s scenario/tests`. Stop and replan if the replacement cannot preserve the stated report behavior. Return an ordered plan only; do not implement.
